title: Chicken Parmesan
description: Tenderized chicken breasts breaded and pan fried, then topped with smooth marinara and cheese and finished in the Anova Precision Oven.

steps.title: Tenderize
steps.text: Tenderize {chicken} with the KitchenAid tenderizer to an even thickness.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season both sides of the chicken lightly with a pinch of kosher salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Bowl 1: flour
steps.text: In the first bowl, mix {flour}, {salt}, {pepper} and {garlicpowder}.

steps.title: Bowl 3: breadcrumbs
steps.text: In the third bowl, mix {breadcrumbs} and {parmbread}.

steps.title: Bread
steps.text: Dredge each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg, then the breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs on.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let the breaded chicken rest for 10 minutes so the coating sets and clings during frying.

steps.title: Heat oil
steps.text: Heat {oil} in a large skillet over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry the chicken 2 1/2 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Move the chicken to a sheet pan. Spread a thin layer of {marinara} on each piece.

steps.title: Finish in the APO
steps.text: Bake in the Anova Precision Oven with the bottom drip pan installed at 425°F Convection Bake, 0% steam, for 10 to 12 minutes until the chicken reaches 160 to 162°F.

notes: Plate the chicken beside the pasta, not on top of it, so the breading stays crisp. Timeline for a 5:30 PM dinner: 4:45 prep chicken and breading, 5:05 start pasta water, 5:10 fry chicken, 5:20 chicken into the APO and pasta into the water, 5:30 serve. Pairs with Impastable Marinara Pasta and APO Roasted Broccoli.
